mainEntity.name: When does post-installation support typically begin and end?

acceptedAnswer.text: Post-installation support typically begins immediately after the final walk-through and project handover. The duration of this support can vary depending on the scope of the project and the specific agreements made. For many elements, initial support might cover a period of 30 to 90 days for adjustments or minor fixes. Extended warranties on certain materials or components may offer longer-term coverage. We establish clear timelines for support during the project planning phase.
